items.a: Morning and evening batches; see this page or message us for today's timings.

items.q: I am a complete beginner — is that okay?
items.a: Yes, most members start as beginners; the trainer starts you slowly and teaches the right form.

items.q: Is there a separate batch for women?
items.a: Ask us — many gyms keep a ladies' timing or section; we will tell you ours.

items.q: Can I take a trial first?
items.a: Yes, message us and come for a trial session before choosing a plan.

items.q: Do you give a diet plan?
items.a: Basic diet guidance comes with training; for a medical condition, consult your doctor too.
For travel or illness, tell us in advance and the days are adjusted where possible.
Cash or UPI, monthly or for a longer plan; ask us the current fees.
